'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Ryan Mason DS Drop''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Mason]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

LTM objective line struck; starts [[Drop! (V)]]. Line 45 Mara Jade struck → [[Vader's Lightsaber]]. Line 52 YCHF & MP as two cards. Line 59 Sense struck (Sim Aloo kept). Imperial Propaganda ×10.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Mason]]

* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Drop! (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
